sentence: I learned to ride a bike when I was four.
synonym: I started cycling at age four
synonymNote: 两者都表示在四岁时学会骑自行车，意思相同。

distractors.word: I forgot how to ride a bike at four
distractors.note: 意思相反，表示忘记而非学会。

distractors.word: I bought a bike when I was four
distractors.note: 表示购买自行车，不是学会骑车。

distractors.word: I watched someone ride a bike at four
distractors.note: 表示观看别人骑车，不是自己学会。
